question: What percentage of the Indian population was estimated to be living below the poverty line in 2011-12?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21.9%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **21.9% **of the Indian population was estimated to be living **below the poverty line.**
 
• This means that around** 270 million people **in India were living below the poverty line in** 2011-12**.
 
• The **poverty line in India **is defined as the minimum level of income required to meet basic needs such as **food, clothing, and shelter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poverty in India** is a major issue, with a **large population** struggling to meet their basic needs.
 
• The poverty line in India is determined by the **Planning Commission, **which takes into account factors such as the **cost of food, health care, and education.**
 
• The poverty line is different for rural and urban areas in India, with the **rural poverty line** being **lower** than the urban poverty line.
 
• **Poverty reduction** has been a priority for the Indian government, with various schemes and programs aimed at improving the** lives of the poor.**
 
• However, progress has been slow and there is still a long way to go in **addressing the issue of poverty** in India.
